question: On which materials may the eight-cremation-ground design be engraved?
premises: The preceding verses prescribe drawing eight cremation grounds with associated figures.
Gold, silver, copper, and gem are listed as possible materials.
The design may be engraved on these materials.
inference: The prescribed eight-cremation-ground diagram can be inscribed on various precious materials.
uncertainties: The accusative form of hiraṇyaṃ contrasts with the locatives of the other materials, leaving its exact syntactic role slightly ambiguous.
plain_english: It may even be engraved on gold, on silver, on copper, or on a gem.
